_about: T34: how deep one capsule may sink before scripts/check_clips.py fails, in metres (Espiochum's limits). Capsules are rough (a bone and a radius), so a little overlap is allowed. off_the_floor names the lower clips whose feet are meant to leave the floor: in the air, and hanging from a vine. contacts lists, per upper clip, bone prefixes meant to touch there (Espiochum's rule): in the slash's wind-up the right arm crosses in front of the chest, nearer than the chest's round capsule allows.
